text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed at inference-gateway (region-us). paging oncall team @alex (oncall) :pager:
alex (oncall): seeing spikes in 502/504s, started ~03:12 UTC. Frontend error rate 6% -> 18% over 5m. dashboards show upstream errors from model-pool replicas.
maria (sre): thanks. Any recent deploys or route changes? I see a canary push 15m ago to gateway routes (weight shift + shadow retry policy).
sam (infra): yep, canary was route-change: added `shadow_retries` config and bumped `route_weight` for canary backend to 20% at 03:00. deploy-bot: deploy 2024-11-07T03:00 by jenny (eng). jenny (eng): i rolled canary to test reduced cold-starts for model v7; didn't touch timeouts intentionally.
alex (oncall): logs from gateway show a lot of `upstream connection reset` and `503 no healthy upstream` from envoy. sample:
```
[2024-11-07T03:14:11Z] envoy upstream reset: connection failure, upstream_reset_reason=connection_failure
[2024-11-07T03:14:11Z] envoy response_code: 502, cluster: model-pool-us
```
maria (sre): curious — the canary config included `retry_policy` in the new route fragment. I pulled the fragment:
```
route:
  retry_policy:
    retry_on: 5xx,connect,refused-stream
    num_retries: 5
    per_try_timeout: 0s   # unintended
```
jenny (eng): whoops — the `per_try_timeout: 0s` was left from a test, meant to be removed. That effectively lets retries pile up.
alex (oncall): that explains amplifier behavior. Retries without per_try_timeout overloads backend connection pool -> circuit-breaker trips -> 503s.
sam (infra): checking envoy stats: model-pool-us circuit_breakers: cx_overflow=1200 in last 5m, retry overflow counts increased, cluster healthy hosts dropped from 10 -> 2.

alex (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) revert canary route weight to 0% 2) disable retries at gateway immediately 3) increase model-pool connection pool temporarily 4) alert customers.
maria (sre): I'll set retry policy to 0 via hotpatch and roll traffic back. executing:
```
# disable retries per-route
kubectl -n gateway exec -it gateway-conf-pod -- /bin/sh -c "apply_patch --route gateway/routes/canary --set retry_policy.num_retries=0"
```
jenny (eng): i'm rolling weight back now to 0% via traffic manager UI.

deploy-bot: action queued: set route_weight(canary)=0 -> applying...
alex (oncall): observing traffic: route weight back to 0% at 03:20. error rate dropping but still above baseline.
maria (sre): hotpatch applied to remove retries at 03:21. envoy metrics: retry_attempts delta -> -95% within 30s.
sam (infra): scaled model-pool-us replicas + increased `max_connections` on the pool by 2x at 03:22 to drain backlog.

alex (oncall): good. customer impact: some long-tail requests still seeing 504s. Which customers hit hardest?
jenny (eng): support matrix: customer_ids A123, B987 showing elevated latencies and request failures across their endpoints. Support pinged customers with initial advisory.

maria (sre): root cause hypothesis: canary introduced a retry config with no per-try timeout. Combined with higher weight, that caused excessive open connections and cx_overflow, tripping envoys CB and returning 502/503. Essentially retry amplification.
sam (infra): additional evidence: envoy logs show `upstream_reset_due_to_excessive_retries` and runtime counters `retry_downstream_overflow`.

alex (oncall): next steps: - create postmortem ticket with timeline & config diff - add validation to deploy pipeline to block `num_retries>0` when `per_try_timeout` is missing - run capacity test for route weights.
jenny (eng): creating ticket: INF-4521
maria (sre): i'm taking on immediate remediation: add a lint rule in route CI to require `per_try_timeout > 0s` if `num_retries > 0`.

alex (oncall): oncall handoff: i'll stay for 30m watch. If error rate back to baseline (<1%) we close paging. otherwise escalate to eng-lead.

deploy-bot: rollback complete: canary weight 0% at 03:20:45 UTC.

sam (infra): metrics: errors back to 0.9% at 03:33, latency p95 normalized. circuit_breaker counters decaying.

alex (oncall): thanks everyone. sending customer update and incident placeholder. We'll capture follow-ups in INF-4521. Closing paging in 10m if stable.

incident-bot: incident status changed -> partial mitigation at 03:35 UTC. paging cleared for oncall.

jenny (eng): notes: create docs for safe retry defaults and add a telemetry alert for cb.cx_overflow > 100 in 5m.
maria (sre): added runbook entry: `if retry amplification suspected -> disable retries -> reduce route weight -> scale upstream -> add per_try_timeout`.

alex (oncall): final: thanks, team. action items assigned in INF-4521. :white_check_mark:
